user.bio: Architecting high-concurrency RESTful microservices, zero-copy network gateways, automated Kubernetes/Docker pipelines, and offline cryptography.
user.about:
- Systems & DevOps Software Engineer specializing in high-concurrency microservices, automated Kubernetes/Docker pipelines, zero-copy network gateways, and offline cryptography.
- Undergraduate in Computer Engineering at Kharazmi University, Tehran, Iran.
- Silver Medalist in the National Innovation Award (Computer Science) 2025.
- Creator of [Oxiroute](https://github.com/pyr0ken/oxiroute) (High-performance Rust AI Gateway, <10MB RSS) and [Khales](https://github.com/pyr0ken/khales) (100% offline privacy PFM with SQLCipher AES-256).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built scalable RESTful APIs with JWT/OAuth2 security, handling thousands of concurrent users.
- Automated deployment using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD (GitLab/GitHub Actions), reducing release time by 40%.
- Cut API latency by 30% with Redis caching and optimized database queries.
- Set up monitoring (Prometheus/Grafana) and centralized logging (ELK) to maintain 99.9% uptime.
- Documented all APIs with Swagger and Postman for seamless team collaboration.

positions.title: Backend Developer
positions.description:
- Developed a booking and CRM system using Django Rest Framework (MVC) with class scheduling, user auth, and subscription packages.
- Integrated secure payment gateways via webhooks and built a ticketing system—prevented double-booking using PostgreSQL transactions.
- Improved database performance by 25% through indexing, optimized SQL, and caching.
- Documented all endpoints with Swagger and created onboarding guides for frontend teams.

projects.title: Interactive 3D Laboratory
projects.description:
Interactive web-based 3D environment for asset visualization, segmentation, and AI integration.
- Upload, render, and edit 3D models with WebGL and React Three Fiber
- Deep learning-driven 3D model segmentation and visual inspection
- Integrated AI capabilities leveraging Computer Vision pipelines and Large Language Models
- Real-time virtual collaborative presentation and review sessions

projects.title: Oxiroute
projects.description:
High-performance, ultra-lightweight AI gateway & LLM router built in pure Rust.
- Ultra-low memory footprint (<10MB RSS) with zero-cost abstractions
- Real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming engine powered by Axum
- Interactive terminal UI (Ratatui) with live throughput metrics and traffic logs
- 3-tier fallback resilience, retry strategies, and intelligent token compaction

projects.title: Online Reservation & CRM Platform
projects.description:
High-concurrency booking and customer relationship management platform.
- Implemented strict PostgreSQL transaction isolation to eliminate double-booking hazards
- Automated subscription scheduling, calendar synchronization, and member ticketing
- Integrated multi-currency payment gateways with webhook reconciliation
- Administrative analytics dashboard with real-time occupancy metrics and audit trails

projects.title: Khales PFM
projects.description:
100% offline, privacy-focused personal finance manager for Android.
- Zero network permissions; all data stays strictly on the physical device
- Encrypted local database utilizing SQLCipher with AES-256 encryption
- Regex-driven Iranian banking SMS transaction parser for automatic expense logging
- Modern UI crafted with Jetpack Compose Material 3 and dynamic financial telemetry

projects.title: E-Commerce Microservices
projects.description:
Scalable online retail engine featuring distributed order orchestration.
- Real-time inventory synchronization and atomic shopping cart state management
- Multi-facet search, categorization, and filtering optimized with Redis caching
- Asynchronous checkout processing with Celery task queues and RabbitMQ brokers
- Dynamic rule-based promotion, coupon, and tiered discount pricing engines

projects.title: Vahedyar — Course Planner
projects.description:
Zero-backend academic course planning and university portal automation suite.
- Instant full-text search across thousands of courses using SQLite FTS5
- High-efficiency Python scraper and Typer CLI client for portal automation
- Interactive schedule visualizer deployed on Vercel with zero latency
